preconditions.description: Input constraints: N is the number of shamans, D is the maximum number of trusted friends, U is the number of days, and Q is the number of queries.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= H_i <= 10**9 for H_i in H) and len(H) == N
preconditions.description: H is a list of N integers representing the altitudes of shamans, each between 0 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= A_i < N and 0 <= B_i < N and A_i != B_i for (A_i, B_i) in trust_log) and len(trust_log) == U
preconditions.description: trust_log is a list of U pairs (A_i, B_i) representing trust changes between shamans, where A_i and B_i are distinct indices.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x < N and 0 <= y < N and x != y and 0 <= v <= U for (x, y, v) in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query consists of x (suspected Thief), y (suspected Evil Shaman), and v (suspected day), where x and y are distinct shamans and v is a valid day index.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= answer <= 10**9 for answer in answers)
postconditions.description: Each answer is a non-negative integer representing the minimum distance or 10^9 if no valid trusted friends exist.

postconditions.expression: all((x, y, v) in queries and (x, y, v, answer) in query_answers for answer in answers)
postconditions.description: Each answer corresponds to a query (x, y, v) and is computed based on the trust relationships on day v.

postconditions.expression: all((x, y, v, answer) in query_answers and (answer == 0 or (x_trusted_friends := get_trusted_friends(x, v)) and (y_trusted_friends := get_trusted_friends(y, v)) and (answer == min(abs(H[x_prime] - H[y_prime]) for x_prime in x_trusted_friends for y_prime in y_trusted_friends) if x_trusted_friends and y_trusted_friends else 10**9)) for (x, y, v, answer) in query_answers)
postconditions.description: For each query (x, y, v), the answer is the minimum distance between any trusted friend of x and any trusted friend of y on day v. If either x or y has no trusted friends, the answer is 10^9. If a shaman is trusted by both x and y (x_prime == y_prime), the distance is 0.

repair_issue.instruction: Add a clause to ensure that the trust relationships are correctly computed for day v based on the trust_log up to day v (inclusive of changes on day v). The current contract does not explicitly state how trust relationships are derived from the trust_log for a given day v.
repair_issue.task_evidence: The Curse is unstable: at the end of each day (exactly at midnight), one pair of shamans will start or stop trusting each other... They have also reconstructed a log of who trusted whom: for each night they know which pair of shamans started/stopped trusting each other at the end of day i-1.
